We’re Hiring: Open Source DBA (L2)
Location: Mumbai / Navi Mumbai
Experience: 3+ Years

Job Summary:
We are looking for an experienced Open Source Database Administrator (L2) with strong
hands-on expertise in MySQL, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL to manage and support
production database environments.

Key Responsibilities:
• Manage end-to-end administration of MongoDB, MySQL & PostgreSQL (Prod/Non-Prod)
• Handle installation, upgrades, replication, clustering & high availability (HA) setups
• Perform backup, restore, performance tuning & troubleshooting
• Manage users, access control, and database security
• Execute disaster recovery (DR) setup, failover testing & data migration
• Monitor logs, resolve incidents & provide support to application teams

Required Skills:
• Strong hands-on experience in MySQL (mandatory)
• Working knowledge of MongoDB & PostgreSQL
• Understanding of replication, database internals & storage engines
• Experience with Linux/Unix systems
• Knowledge of HA/DR concepts & production support (L2)
• Willingness to work in shifts/on-call support
